    • findByRecruitmentId

      List<RecruitmentCourse> findByRecruitmentId(Long recruitmentId)
      Every row for a recruitment, removed ones included. Callers filter and sort in Java: the padded course id only sorts correctly under code-unit ordering, and Postgres' collation can treat spaces as negligible.

    • findByInstructor

      List<RecruitmentCourse> findByInstructor(String instructor)
      Every row, in any recruitment, whose instructor of record is the given catalog name (issue #127). Removed rows are included; callers filter.
